description: Shared Renovate preset for lsimons/ repos; see README.md in lsimons/.github.

packageRules.description: Never move TypeScript to a new major (6 -> 7 needs explicit agreement; Astro needs the TS 6 API).

Compatibility floors, not dependencies: pyproject requires-python, package.json engines, the go.mod go directive. rangeStrategy pin would turn ">=3.15" into "==3.15.x" (or raise the go floor) and automerge it. go.mod toolchain and the mise pins still update.
A Python minor (3.15 -> 3.16) is a language upgrade: its own PR, no automerge. Covers mise, .python-version and python Docker images.

zizmor-action's version input is looked up on GHCR, which has no release timestamps (so no 7-day wait). Look it up on zizmor's GitHub releases instead: the same 7-day wait as the mise zizmor pin, so both land in the same non-major PR.

customManagers.description: prek.toml remote hook repos: repo = "https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>" followed by rev = "<tag>", or rev = "<sha>" # <tag>.
Renovate itself: renovate-version in the runner workflow, and the validator image in .mise.toml (looked up on npm, which has release timestamps; GHCR does not).
